source_attribution: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, 2021-07-28 statement, extracted HTML text.

claims.text: 联邦基金利率目标区间维持在0至1/4%。

citations.quotation: The Committee decided to keep the target range for the federal funds rate at 0 to 1/4 percent

claims.text: 每月至少增持800亿美元国债。

citations.quotation: it would continue to increase its holdings of Treasury securities by at least $80 billion per month

claims.text: 每月至少增持400亿美元机构抵押贷款支持证券。

citations.quotation: and of agency mortgage‑backed securities by at least $40 billion per month until substantial further progress has been made toward its maximum employment and price stability goals.

claims.text: 经济路径仍取决于疫情走向，即疫情仍是声明中指出的经济风险。

citations.quotation: The path of the economy continues to depend on the course of the virus.

counterarguments.text: 所提供节选未包含关于就业或通胀尚未完全恢复的明确表述；资产购买将持续'直到在最大就业和价格稳定目标方面取得实质性进一步进展'，这暗示这些目标尚未完全实现，但仅为推断。

citations.quotation: until substantial further progress has been made toward its maximum employment and price stability goals.

limitations: 提供的来源为节选（source_coverage 为 partial），并非2021年7月28日FOMC声明的全文，无法核实声明中其他风险或未恢复领域的表述（如就业缺口、通胀等具体措辞）。
来源声明的发布时间为声明标注时间，未经独立核实。
